mapper.select: INSERT INTO journal_entry (transaction_event_id, journal_entry_type_id, booked, posted) VALUES ( #{transactionEvent.transactionEventId}, (SELECT journal_entry_type_id FROM journal_entry_type WHERE code = #{journalEntryType.code}), now(), now() ) RETURNING journal_entry_id

INSERT INTO journal_entry_line (journal_entry_id, register_id, currency_id, quantity) VALUES ( #{journalEntryId}, #{journalEntryLine.register.registerId}, (SELECT currency_id FROM currency WHERE currency_code = #{journalEntryLine.amount.currency.currencyCode}), #{journalEntryLine.amount.quantity} ) RETURNING journal_entry_line_id

SELECT currency.currency_code, merchant_line.quantity AS fee, merchant_line.register_id AS merchant_pending_fee_register_id, merchant_type.register_type_code AS merchant_register_type, merchant_register.account_id AS merchant_account_id, platform_line.register_id AS platform_pending_fee_register_id, platform_type.register_type_code AS platform_register_type, platform_register.account_id AS platform_account_id FROM transaction payment JOIN transaction_event event ON event.transaction_id = payment.transaction_id JOIN transaction_event_type event_type ON event_type.transaction_event_type_id = event.transaction_event_type_id AND event_type.code = 'ORDER_CREATED' JOIN journal_entry entry ON entry.transaction_event_id = event.transaction_event_id JOIN journal_entry_type entry_type ON entry_type.journal_entry_type_id = entry.journal_entry_type_id AND entry_type.code = 'FEE_PENDING' JOIN journal_entry_line merchant_line ON merchant_line.journal_entry_id = entry.journal_entry_id JOIN register merchant_register ON merchant_register.register_id = merchant_line.register_id AND merchant_register.account_id = payment.account_id JOIN register_type merchant_type ON merchant_type.register_type_id = merchant_register.register_type_id JOIN journal_entry_line platform_line ON platform_line.journal_entry_id = entry.journal_entry_id AND platform_line.journal_entry_line_id <> merchant_line.journal_entry_line_id JOIN register platform_register ON platform_register.register_id = platform_line.register_id JOIN register_type platform_type ON platform_type.register_type_id = platform_register.register_type_id JOIN currency ON currency.currency_id = merchant_line.currency_id WHERE payment.transaction_id = #{paymentTransactionId}

SELECT MAX(line.register_id) FILTER (WHERE register_type.register_type_code = 'PSP_RECEIVABLE') AS psp_receivable_register_id, MAX(register.account_id) FILTER (WHERE register_type.register_type_code = 'PSP_RECEIVABLE') AS psp_account_id, MAX(line.register_id) FILTER (WHERE register_type.register_type_code = 'TAX_PAYABLE') AS tax_payable_register_id, MAX(register.account_id) FILTER (WHERE register_type.register_type_code = 'TAX_PAYABLE') AS tax_authority_account_id, MAX(line.register_id) FILTER (WHERE register_type.register_type_code = 'MERCHANT_PAYABLE') AS merchant_payable_register_id, MAX(register.account_id) FILTER (WHERE register_type.register_type_code = 'MERCHANT_PAYABLE') AS merchant_account_id, MAX(line.register_id) FILTER (WHERE register_type.register_type_code = 'FEE_REVENUE') AS fee_revenue_register_id, MAX(register.account_id) FILTER (WHERE register_type.register_type_code = 'FEE_REVENUE') AS platform_account_id FROM transaction capture JOIN transaction_type capture_type ON capture_type.transaction_type_id = capture.transaction_type_id AND capture_type.code = 'CAPTURE' JOIN transaction_event event ON event.transaction_id = capture.transaction_id JOIN journal_entry entry ON entry.transaction_event_id = event.transaction_event_id JOIN journal_entry_type entry_type ON entry_type.journal_entry_type_id = entry.journal_entry_type_id AND entry_type.code = 'CAPTURE' JOIN journal_entry_line line ON line.journal_entry_id = entry.journal_entry_id JOIN register ON register.register_id = line.register_id JOIN register_type ON register_type.register_type_id = register.register_type_id WHERE capture.parent_transaction_id = #{paymentTransactionId} HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
